officialInventory.summary: The National Protected Area Authority (NPAA), created by the National Protected Areas Authority and Conservation Trust Fund Act 2012, manages national parks and wildlife sanctuaries; forest reserves remain with the Forestry Division, and the four estuarine Marine Protected Areas were declared by the Ministry of Fisheries and Marine Resources. NPAA's website has a 'List of National Protected Areas' page, but it was empty when fetched (Oct 2026) and the site contains template placeholder content. The best official descriptions are the NBSAP 2017–2026 (protected-area categories under the Wildlife Conservation Act 1972, gazetted national parks, Table 9 of major forest-estate components, Table 2 of estuarine MPAs) and the 6th CBD national report (2020). No complete official register was found.

statedCounts.quote: The country has an existing network of 48 reserve areas with 15 designated protected areas, covering 284,591 hectares (Government of Sierra Leone 2011). This includes four national parks, two wildlife sanctuaries and a collection of forest reserves
The gazetted national parks are Outamba-Kilimi NP, Gola Forest NP, Loma Mountain NP and Western Area Peninsula NP.
Four Marine Protected Areas (MPAs) were declared in 2010 as significant component of the protection of coastal and marine ecosystems.
In total there are 29 forest reserves, a significant number of which have been upgraded for higher protection categories across the country.

areas.name: Outamba-Kilimi National Park
areas.notes: 110,900 ha in two portions: Outamba 74,100 ha and Kilimi 36,800 ha (NBSAP).

areas.name: Gola Rainforest National Park

legalStatus.text: Upgraded from forest reserves to national park status (December 2011 per NBSAP; 2013 per NR6)

areas.notes: 77,044 ha in NBSAP Table 9; 'a little over 74,000 ha' elsewhere in NBSAP. Year conflict 2011 vs 2013. Part of the Gola-Tiwai Complex World Heritage site (2025, per NR7; handled separately).

areas.name: Loma Mountains National Park

legalStatus.text: Upgraded from Non-hunting Forest Reserve to National Park in 2015 (NR6)

areas.notes: 33,200 ha (NBSAP Table 9). Includes Bintumani peak.

areas.name: Western Area Peninsula National Park
areas.localName: Western Area Peninsula Forest National Park

legalStatus.text: Declared a National Park following a 2012 biodiversity and carbon assessment (NR6); formerly a Non-hunting Forest Reserve

areas.notes: 17,800 ha (NBSAP Table 9, listed as 'Western Area Peninsula Forest NHFR'). Declaration year not stated precisely.

areas.name: Tiwai Island Wildlife Sanctuary
areas.notes: NBSAP describes Tiwai Island under the Game Reserve category and calls it a sanctuary; NR6 names it 'Tiwai Island Wildlife Sanctuary'; NR7 'Tiwai Island Game Sanctuary'. Part of the Gola-Tiwai Complex World Heritage site (2025).

areas.name: Mamunta-Mayosso Wildlife Sanctuary
areas.notes: NBSAP: 'Mamunta-Mayosso is currently the only Game Sanctuary in the country.' Inland wetland with two lakes; co-management plan 2015 (NR6).

areas.name: Kangari Hills Non-Hunting Forest Reserve
areas.notes: 8,573 ha (NBSAP Table 9).

areas.name: Tingi Hills Non-Hunting Forest Reserve
areas.notes: 11,885 ha (NBSAP Table 9).

areas.name: Tonkoli Forest Reserve
areas.notes: 47,656 ha (NBSAP Table 9, Northern Province).

areas.name: Kambui Hills Forest Reserve
areas.notes: 21,213 ha (NBSAP Table 9, Eastern Province).

areas.name: Dodo Hills Forest Reserve
areas.notes: 21,185 ha (NBSAP Table 9, Eastern Province).

areas.name: Tama Forest Reserve
areas.notes: 17,094 ha (NBSAP Table 9, Northern Province).

areas.name: Nimini Hills Forest Reserve
areas.notes: Printed 'Nimimi Hills Forest Reserve' in NBSAP Table 9; 15,557 ha (Eastern Province).

areas.name: Kuru Hills Forest Reserve
areas.notes: 7,001 ha (NBSAP Table 9, Northern Province).

areas.name: Kasewe Forest Reserve
areas.notes: 2,333 ha (NBSAP Table 9, Northern Province).

areas.name: Moyamba Hills Forest Reserve
areas.notes: 'ca4000' ha (approximate) in NBSAP Table 9, Southern Province.

areas.name: Scarcies River Estuary Marine Protected Area

legalStatus.text: Declared by the Ministry of Fisheries and Marine Resources (2010 per NBSAP; NR6 also refers to 'the declaration of Marine Protected in 2012')

areas.notes: Mangrove estate 13,407 ha (NBSAP Table 2); total MPA area not given.

areas.name: Sierra Leone River Estuary Marine Protected Area

legalStatus.text: Declared by the Ministry of Fisheries and Marine Resources (2010 per NBSAP; 2012 per NR6)

areas.notes: Estuary spatial extent ~259,000 ha, mangroves 34,234 ha (NBSAP Table 2). Also an IBA and Ramsar site (handled separately).

areas.name: Yawri Bay Marine Protected Area

legalStatus.text: Declared by the Ministry of Fisheries and Marine Resources (2010 per NBSAP; 2012 per NR6)

areas.notes: Printed 'Yaw Bay' in NBSAP Table 2 (spatial extent ~31,605 ha, mangroves 24,505 ha).

areas.name: Sherbro River Estuary Marine Protected Area

legalStatus.text: Declared by the Ministry of Fisheries and Marine Resources (2010 per NBSAP; 2012 per NR6)

areas.notes: Mangrove estate 99,854 ha (NBSAP Table 2).

areas.name: Lake Sonfon
areas.notes: NBSAP: 'There are proposals for Lake Sonfon and environs, Lakes Mape and Mabesi to be upgraded to national park status.'

areas.name: Lakes Mape and Mabesi
areas.notes: Proposed for national park status (NBSAP 2017–2026).

notEnumerated.reason: NBSAP gives 29 forest reserves in total (also 'about 24 forest reserves' elsewhere) but lists only the major ones (Table 9); no complete official list found.

gaps: No complete official list was retrievable: the NPAA 'List of National Protected Areas' page was empty when fetched.
Gazettement instruments (Government Notices/Statutory Instruments) were not located for any area; years come from NBSAP/NR6 narrative and conflict for Gola (2011 vs 2013) and the MPAs (2010 vs 2012).
MPA boundaries/areas not documented in fetched sources (only mangrove areas). Whether additional MPAs were declared after 2017 was not verified.
NR7 (2026) states a target to expand protected areas but gives no updated list.
